decisions.decision: Use a collapsible narrative guide derived from the existing facility draft.
decisions.why: Provides order and context without a second draft or persisted readiness flags.

decisions.decision: Expose the existing recoveryProgramId choice in command-action authoring.
decisions.why: A guide that creates a program also needs a usable path to connect it to a player command.
decisions.rejected: Instructions pointing at a configuration option the UI did not provide.

decisions.decision: Use an explicitly labeled save checkpoint before guide navigation to terminal editing when the facility draft is dirty
decisions.why: Terminal editing autosaves and otherwise invalidates the retained facility draft; successful save preserves the selected device and refreshes the catalog on return
decisions.rejected: Implicit autosave, silent discard, automatic merging, or a second draft store

decisions.decision: Explain missing recovery transitions with a direct selected-device editor action
decisions.why: Optional recovery should remain discoverable without being reported as a readiness error

concerns.note: An initial recovery test assumed an unused command in a fully configured fixture; corrected it to edit an existing command. No residual failure.
